title: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current evaluation of LLMs on benchmarks typically aggregates performance over individual examples into a single scalar score. This approach is overly coarse and ignores the diverse scope of skills covered by benchmark datasets. To address this limitation and better exploit benchmark data, we propose SkillEval, a new evaluation framework that performs cross-model, skill-level analysis. The framework integrates advances from two areas: (1) it leverages the meta-cognitive capabilities of LLMs to automatically discover interpretable skills from questions, and (2) it applies cognitive diagnosis models (CDMs) from psychometrics to estimate per-skill abilities of LLMs. We conduct experiments on 3,811 LLMs evaluated on 9,523 items across five benchmarks spanning diverse domains (MATH, BBH, GPQA, MuSR, IFEval). Compared to the traditional average-based evaluation paradigm, SkillEval produces reliable, more calibrated and informative yet concise

translated_title: SkillEval：通过认知诊断模型学习大语言模型的可解释能力画像
translated_abstract: 当前对大语言模型在基准测试上的评估通常将单个样本上的表现汇总为一个标量分数。这种方法过于粗糙，忽略了基准数据集所涵盖的多样化技能范围。为了解决这一局限并更好地利用基准数据，我们提出了 SkillEval，一个全新的评估框架，能够进行跨模型、技能级别的分析。该框架整合了两个领域的进展：（1）利用大语言模型的元认知能力，从题目中自动发现可解释的技能；（2）应用心理测量学中的认知诊断模型（CDMs）来估计大语言模型在每项技能上的能力。我们在五个覆盖不同领域的基准（MATH、BBH、GPQA、MuSR、IFEval）上，对 3,811 个大语言模型在 9,523 个题目上进行了实验。与传统的基于平均分的评估范式相比，SkillEval 产生了可靠、更校准、信息更丰富且简洁的结果。
tldr: SkillEval 结合大语言模型的元认知能力与心理测量学中的认知诊断模型，从基准题目中自动发现可解释的技能，并为大语言模型生成跨模型的技能级能力画像，相比传统平均分评估更可靠、更校准且信息更丰富。
en_tdlr: SkillEval integrates the meta-cognitive capabilities of LLMs with cognitive diagnosis models from psychometrics to automatically discover interpretable skills from benchmark questions and estimate per-skill abilities, producing cross-model, skill-level ability profiles that are more reliable, better calibrated, and more informative than traditional average-based evaluation.
